name: Urukku Manush v2.2.2
changelog:
• In-Game Score Meter toggle: Hide the HUD score meter while jumping for a clean view, with full score displayed on Game Over.
• Score Meter toggle added to both Game Settings and Pause Menu with persistent memory.
• Optical centering and spacious layout upgrade for the Pause Menu.
• Brand new BGM tracks: bgm_1 and bgm_2 added with seamless random in-game music shuffling.
• Push notification empty bubble fix with rich rivalry alerts.
